newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNAIR RISES SHARPLY IN BRISK TRADE.
newsitem.headline: FINNAIR RISES SHARPLY IN BRISK TRADE.

text.p: Shares in Finnish national carrier Finnair rose sharply on Friday in brisk demand on momentum from a rise through technical resistance levels this week and a recent recommendation on the share, brokers said.
At 1420/1120 GMT, Finnair traded at 43.00 markka, up 2.00 markka or almost five percent, in 18 million markka volume.
"Finnair has stood still for so long, and now it has finally gone through 40.00 markka and has momentum behind it," one broker said. Finnair cleared 40.00 on Wednesday.
Another broker said the share was still being helped by a outperform rating from Den Danske Bank issued on July 10.
